reproduce: java -jar IrpTransmogrifier-1.2.14-jar-with-dependencies.jar render -n <params> -r <protocol>, e.g. -n D=8,F=175 -r Denon; the output is [intro][repeat][ending] in signed microseconds, written here as absolute values; every ending is empty
note: 34 parameter sets per protocol: the corners, the published decodes, and a seeded random sample (random.Random(20260922)). tests/test_irpt_sweeps_japan.py requires every intro and repeat duration to be identical.
